university: The University of Texas at Austin

programme.title: Bachelor of Science (BS) in Computer Science
programme.degree: BS in Computer Science, 120 hours (BSA also offered; Turing Scholars honors option)
programme.how_found: cs.utexas.edu undergraduate pages; university-wide admissions (admissions.utexas.edu) and Texas One Stop (onestop.utexas.edu) for english, deadline, cost and scholarships (owner ruling: US university-wide pages acceptable).
programme.notes: Applicants choose first- and second-choice majors on the application; the CS major may require additional items listed by the college.

english.quote: Minimum scores acceptable for admission are: TOEFL: 79 (120 scale) or 4 (6-point scale) internet-based test IELTS: An overall band of 6.5 on the Academic Examination DET: 115 minimum overall score
english.notes: University-wide. No IELTS sub-band minimum. Exempt if from a qualifying country or graduating after at least three years of study in the US or a qualifying country. ITP, TOEFL Essentials and IELTS General Training not accepted.

gpa.notes: No minimum GPA or grade threshold published for international first-year applicants on the pages read; holistic review.

extra_quotes: Applicants who receive a notification of deferral and regular deadline applicants will receive a decision by February 15, 2027.
deadline.notes: International Students page, Key Dates, Summer/Fall Enrollment: Early Action October 15, Regular Decision December 1 (supplemental materials December 10). Decisions dated 2027 on the same page, so the cycle is fall 2027 entry; the deadline itself is printed WITHOUT a year. No time zone.

extra_quotes: Fall & Spring Semesters for Full-Time Undergraduate
tuition.notes: Cost of attendance for 'the 2026-27 academic year', Fall & Spring semesters, non-resident: a RANGE, $42,554-$51,106 (varies by college/program; College of Natural Sciences adds a $500 non-resident differential per semester, included in advertised rates). No single amount; no 2027-28 figure. International students pay the non-resident rate.

value.name: Incoming Student Scholarships (UT Austin Office of Scholarships and Financial Aid)

scholarship_exists.quote: Incoming students who do not submit a FAFSA/TASFA will still be considered for scholarships that do not require financial need.
scholarship_exists.notes: Apply for admission by December 1; no separate scholarship application (Scholarship Interest Form in MyStatus). Merit and need-based; amounts not published per award except Impact Scholarships ($12,000/year, selection uses FAFSA - a US federal form). Competitive.

scholarship_international.notes: No page read states whether international students are eligible for incoming-student scholarships. The TASFA mention covers Texas non-citizen residents, not international students. Not established.
